analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-buffer-overflow read in UnpredictICC due to missing bounds validation of source offset `pos` against input `size` before copying `num` bytes in the `kCommandPredict` path. The code checks `CheckOutOfBounds(pos, num, size)` but then reads from `enc[pos + i]`; with crafted command/data layout, `pos` can equal `size` while `num` is accepted, leading to a 1-byte OOB read at `enc[size]` (crash at line ~287).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `icc_codec_fuzzer`, first byte selects read mode (`data[0]==0`), then remaining bytes are passed to `UnpredictICC`. A malformed encoded ICC stream must drive parsing into the main-content `kCommandPredict` branch with varints/commands that make `pos` point to the end of the input while the copy loop still executes for `num` bytes. This causes `shuffled[i] = enc[pos + i]` to read past the allocated fuzz input buffer.
